key_catalyst: Escalating US-Iran conflict and Strait of Hormuz closure claim triggering a global risk-off supply shock
reasoning: A novel, escalating US-Iran military conflict with a Strait of Hormuz closure claim erupted over the weekend, spiking Brent crude and driving a global risk-off move that pushed QQQ down 1.19% in pre-market. This geopolitical shock is compounding fresh upward pressure on Treasury yields and a severe Asian tech/semiconductor selloff (KOSPI -6.67%), none of which the market has absorbed. All three catalysts are same-day, unresolved, and actively generating new negative headlines heading into major CPI and Fed testimony events on July 14.
